beforeSubmitPrompt.command: ROOT=$(/usr/bin/git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || { printf '%s\n' '{"continue":true}'; exit 0; }; export CODEX_PRMONITOR_STATE_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cursor-prmonitor"; INPUT=$(cat); NORM=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | "$PY" -c 'import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); e["hook_event_name"]="UserPromptSubmit"; e.setdefault("session_id", str(e.get("conversation_id") or "")); e.setdefault("turn_id", str(e.get("generation_id") or e.get("session_id") or "")); roots=e.get("workspace_roots") or []; e.setdefault("cwd", roots[0] if roots else ""); json.dump(e, sys.stdout)'); printf '%s' "$NORM" | "$PY" "$ROOT/.codex/hooks/prmonitor_hook.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\n' '{"continue":true}'

stop.command: ROOT=$(/usr/bin/git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || exit 0; export CODEX_PRMONITOR_STATE_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cursor-prmonitor"; INPUT=$(cat); NORM=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | "$PY" -c 'import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); e["hook_event_name"]="Stop"; e.setdefault("stop_reason", str(e.get("status") or "Cursor agent stopped")); e.setdefault("session_id", str(e.get("conversation_id") or "")); e.setdefault("turn_id", str(e.get("generation_id") or e.get("session_id") or "")); roots=e.get("workspace_roots") or []; e.setdefault("cwd", roots[0] if roots else ""); json.dump(e, sys.stdout)'); printf '%s' "$NORM" | "$PY" "$ROOT/.codex/hooks/prmonitor_hook.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\n' '{}'
